title: Structural modifications of toxyloxanthone C and macluraxanthone isolated from Maclura cochinchinensis: cytotoxicity, antibacterial activity, and in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33816-33829
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05758B, Paper

Chaiwat Linphosan, Waranya Klangsawad, Jantana Yahuafai, Jinda Jandaruang, Trinop Promgool, Siripit Pitchuanchom, Jakkapat Paluka, Sophon Boonlue, Kitisak Poopasit, Kwanjai Kanokmedhakul, Oue-artorn Limtragool
Thirteen xanthone derivatives were synthesized through the structural modification of toxyloxanthone C (1) and macluraxanthone (2). The acetylated and brominated derivatives of 1 exhibited enhanced anticancer and antibacterial activities.
